//: Screenshot manifest — checked in, so every image in the user guides is
REGENERABLE rather than hand-pasted. Hand-pasted screenshots are the
reason screenshot documentation rots: nobody re-takes forty images.
Run against a fixture-seeded environment, NEVER production or a real
user account — a shipped screenshot containing real names, emails, or
account numbers is a data-leak incident.
With no browser automation tool available, this file is still written and
committed; the generation step reports NOT RUN. Wiring a tool up later
produces the images with no change to the guides.

defaults.//deviceScaleFactor: 2 gives readable images on high-DPI displays; it doubles file size, so drop to 1 if the repo is size-sensitive.
defaults.//theme: Pin the theme. Without this, whoever runs it in dark mode produces a guide that matches nobody else's.

//auth: How the run authenticates. Keep the VALUE in an env var; this file is committed.

shots.//: waitFor a SELECTOR, never a fixed delay — a sleep screenshots a spinner on a slow run and passes on a fast one.
shots.//mask: Privacy control, not cosmetic. Blank anything identifying before capture.
shots.caption: The order list after at least one order exists.

shots.//: Error states are worth screenshotting: they are what a user sees when stuck, and are the hardest thing to describe in words.
shots.caption: Submitting an empty form shows which fields are required.

shots.//: Override defaults per shot when the guide covers a responsive layout.
shots.caption: Order detail on a phone-sized viewport.
